panels.title: 0 · Event health: is the instrumentation alive?
Every registered event: count, sessions, last seen
panels.description: The registry is analytics.ts EVENT_NAMES (a unit test keeps this list equal to it). 'never fired' in the range is not 'unused', it is the first suspect after a release. 'off-registry' is a name the app sent that the registry does not have.

targets.rawSql:
WITH reg(name) AS (VALUES ('screen_view'),('landing_view'),('landing_cta_click'),('landing_teaser_click'),('auth_started'),('auth_completed'),('auth_failed'),('interests_picker_shown'),('interests_saved'),('interests_dismissed'),('trends_row_click'),('browse_tab_view'),('entity_open'),('episode_open'),('follow'),('unfollow'),('search_submitted'),('search_result_click'),('share_link_opened'),('play_start'),('knowledge_panel_open'),('insight_tap'),('transcript_seek'),('capture_created'),('recap_view'),('revisit_open'),('queue_add'),('collection_add'),('download_start'),('share'),('route_output'),('highlights_export'),('speed_change'),('error_shown'),('empty_state_shown'),('offline_session'),('update_prompt'),('app_launch'),('app_resume'),('push_permission'),('notification_open'),('email_link_opened'),('discover_rail_shown'),('discover_rail_tap'),('learn_path'),('reel_open'),('reel_action'),('trends_show_more'),('catalog_filter')),
sess AS (
  SELECT s.session_id, coalesce(s.distinct_id, s.session_id::text) AS person, s.distinct_id
  FROM session s
  LEFT JOIN session_data ch ON ch.session_id = s.session_id AND ch.data_key = 'channel'
  LEFT JOIN session_data pl ON pl.session_id = s.session_id AND pl.data_key = 'platform'
  LEFT JOIN session_data av ON av.session_id = s.session_id AND av.data_key = 'app_version'
  WHERE s.website_id = '$site'
    AND ('$channel' = 'All' OR ch.string_value = '$channel')
    AND ('$platform' = 'All' OR pl.string_value = '$platform')
    AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR av.string_value = '$app_version')
),
ev AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.session_id, e.visit_id, e.created_at, e.event_name, sess.person
  FROM website_event e JOIN sess ON sess.session_id = e.session_id
  WHERE e.website_id = '$site' AND e.event_type = 2 AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
    AND e.event_name !~ '^uaprobe-'
),
agg AS (SELECT event_name, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions, max(created_at) AS last_seen FROM ev GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(reg.name, agg.event_name) AS event, coalesce(agg.n, 0) AS events,
  coalesce(agg.sessions, 0) AS sessions, agg.last_seen,
  CASE WHEN reg.name IS NULL THEN 'off-registry' WHEN agg.event_name IS NULL THEN 'never fired' ELSE 'ok' END AS status
FROM reg FULL JOIN agg ON agg.event_name = reg.name
ORDER BY CASE WHEN reg.name IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN agg.event_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, events DESC

panels.title: By app version (did a release break something?)
panels.description: Native sessions by app_version: sessions, events and how many distinct event names each build sent. A build that sends far fewer distinct names than the one before lost instrumentation.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sess AS (
  SELECT s.session_id, coalesce(s.distinct_id, s.session_id::text) AS person, s.distinct_id
  FROM session s
  LEFT JOIN session_data ch ON ch.session_id = s.session_id AND ch.data_key = 'channel'
  LEFT JOIN session_data pl ON pl.session_id = s.session_id AND pl.data_key = 'platform'
  LEFT JOIN session_data av ON av.session_id = s.session_id AND av.data_key = 'app_version'
  WHERE s.website_id = '$site'
    AND ('$channel' = 'All' OR ch.string_value = '$channel')
    AND ('$platform' = 'All' OR pl.string_value = '$platform')
    AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR av.string_value = '$app_version')
),
ev AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.session_id, e.visit_id, e.created_at, e.event_name, sess.person
  FROM website_event e JOIN sess ON sess.session_id = e.session_id
  WHERE e.website_id = '$site' AND e.event_type = 2 AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at)

FROM ev LEFT JOIN session_data av ON av.session_id = ev.session_id AND av.data_key = 'app_version'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Onboarding funnel: people reaching each step

  FROM session s
  LEFT JOIN session_data ch ON ch.session_id = s.session_id AND ch.data_key = 'channel'
  LEFT JOIN session_data pl ON pl.session_id = s.session_id AND pl.data_key = 'platform'
  LEFT JOIN session_data av ON av.session_id = s.session_id AND av.data_key = 'app_version'
  WHERE s.website_id = '$site'
    AND ('$channel' = 'All' OR ch.string_value = '$channel')
    AND ('$platform' = 'All' OR pl.string_value = '$platform')
    AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR av.string_value = '$app_version')
),
ev AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.session_id, e.visit_id, e.created_at, e.event_name, sess.person
  FROM website_event e JOIN sess ON sess.session_id = e.session_id
  WHERE e.website_id = '$site' AND e.event_type = 2 AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
    AND e.event_name !~ '^uaprobe-'
),
steps(ord, step, names) AS (VALUES
  (1, '1 landing_view', ARRAY['landing_view']), (2, '2 landing_cta_click', ARRAY['landing_cta_click']),
  (3, '3 auth_started', ARRAY['auth_started']), (4, '4 auth_completed', ARRAY['auth_completed']),

  (6, '6 episode_open', ARRAY['episode_open']), (7, '7 play_start', ARRAY['play_start']))
SELECT steps.step, count(DISTINCT ev.person) AS people
FROM steps LEFT JOIN ev ON ev.event_name = ANY (steps.names)
GROUP BY steps.ord, steps.step ORDER BY steps.ord

Activated within 24h of first seen

  SELECT s.session_id, coalesce(s.distinct_id, s.session_id::text) AS person, s.distinct_id
  FROM session s
  LEFT JOIN session_data ch ON ch.session_id = s.session_id AND ch.data_key = 'channel'
  LEFT JOIN session_data pl ON pl.session_id = s.session_id AND pl.data_key = 'platform'
  LEFT JOIN session_data av ON av.session_id = s.session_id AND av.data_key = 'app_version'
  WHERE s.website_id = '$site'
    AND ('$channel' = 'All' OR ch.string_value = '$channel')
    AND ('$platform' = 'All' OR pl.string_value = '$platform')
    AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR av.string_value = '$app_version')

ev AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.session_id, e.visit_id, e.created_at, e.event_name, sess.person
  FROM website_event e JOIN sess ON sess.session_id = e.session_id
  WHERE e.website_id = '$site' AND e.event_type = 2 AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
    AND e.event_name !~ '^uaprobe-'
),
first AS (SELECT person, min(created_at) AS t0 FROM ev WHERE person IN (SELECT distinct_id FROM sess WHERE distinct_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY 1),
per AS (SELECT f.person,
  bool_or(ev.event_name = 'play_start' AND ev.created_at < f.t0 + interval '24 hours') AS played,
  bool_or(ev.event_name = 'entity_open' AND ev.created_at < f.t0 + interval '24 hours') AS pivoted
  FROM first f JOIN ev ON ev.person = f.person GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE count(*) FILTER (WHERE played AND pivoted)::numeric / count(*) END AS activated FROM per

Active days per participant
panels.description: Identified participants: first and last seen, distinct active days in the range, days active in the last 7 days. Umami only sees the app while it is open and online; server listens (right) are the ground truth for listening, but carry no participant id, so they compare as daily totals only.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sess AS (
  SELECT s.session_id, coalesce(s.distinct_id, s.session_id::text) AS person, s.distinct_id
  FROM session s
  LEFT JOIN session_data ch ON ch.session_id = s.session_id AND ch.data_key = 'channel'
  LEFT JOIN session_data pl ON pl.session_id = s.session_id AND pl.data_key = 'platform'
  LEFT JOIN session_data av ON av.session_id = s.session_id AND av.data_key = 'app_version'
  WHERE s.website_id = '$site'
    AND ('$channel' = 'All' OR ch.string_value = '$channel')
    AND ('$platform' = 'All' OR pl.string_value = '$platform')
    AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR av.string_value = '$app_version')
),
ev AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.session_id, e.visit_id, e.created_at, e.event_name, sess.person
  FROM website_event e JOIN sess ON sess.session_id = e.session_id
  WHERE e.website_id = '$site' AND e.event_type = 2 AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
    AND e.event_name !~ '^uaprobe-'

panels.title: 8 · Discover: do the rails earn their place?
Rails shown vs tapped
panels.description: discover_rail_shown and discover_rail_tap {rail}: per rail, sessions that saw it, taps, and taps per session shown. A rail shown often and never tapped is either uninteresting or its tap event is broken.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sess AS (
  SELECT s.session_id, coalesce(s.distinct_id, s.session_id::text) AS person, s.distinct_id
  FROM session s
  LEFT JOIN session_data ch ON ch.session_id = s.session_id AND ch.data_key = 'channel'
  LEFT JOIN session_data pl ON pl.session_id = s.session_id AND pl.data_key = 'platform'
  LEFT JOIN session_data av ON av.session_id = s.session_id AND av.data_key = 'app_version'
  WHERE s.website_id = '$site'
    AND ('$channel' = 'All' OR ch.string_value = '$channel')
    AND ('$platform' = 'All' OR pl.string_value = '$platform')
    AND ('$app_version' = 'All' OR av.string_value = '$app_version')
),
ev AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.session_id, e.visit_id, e.created_at, e.event_name, sess.person
  FROM website_event e JOIN sess ON sess.session_id = e.session_id
  WHERE e.website_id = '$site' AND e.event_type = 2 AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
    AND e.event_name !~ '^uaprobe-'
),
shown AS (SELECT d_rail.string_value AS rail, count(DISTINCT ev.session_id) AS sessions_shown FROM ev LEFT JOIN event_data d_rail ON d_rail.website_event_id = ev.event_id AND d_rail.data_key = 'rail' WHERE ev.event_name = 'discover_rail_shown' GROUP BY 1),
tapped AS (SELECT d_rail.string_value AS rail, count(*) AS taps FROM ev LEFT JOIN event_data d_rail ON d_rail.website_event_id = ev.event_id AND d_rail.data_key = 'rail' WHERE ev.event_name = 'discover_rail_tap' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(shown.rail, tapped.rail) AS rail, coalesce(sessions_shown, 0) AS sessions_shown, coalesce(taps, 0) AS taps,
  round(coalesce(taps, 0)::numeric / nullif(sessions_shown, 0), 2) AS taps_per_session_shown
FROM shown FULL JOIN tapped ON tapped.rail = shown.rail ORDER BY 2 DESC
